purpose: compare alternative ecological-state probabilistic forecasters on the same independent rows without collapsing transferability, calibration and sharpness into one confidence score
decision_order: compute each independent group's mean gain separately
classify transfer as all-positive, all-nonpositive or mixed without pooled rescue
if coverage evidence exists, require absolute empirical-minus-target coverage error <= declared tolerance before trusted admission
compare admitted candidates on held-out log-density gain and sharpness without forming an aggregate confidence score

obligations: overconfident candidate is rejected despite larger pooled log-density gain
mixed candidate remains mixed even when its pooled gain is positive
broad calibrated candidate is admissible but is Pareto-dominated by the sharper higher-gain well-calibrated candidate
recommended trusted candidate is the well-calibrated informative candidate
no aggregate confidence score is emitted
